headline: OPEC+ maintains December oil output targets amid Iran supply disruptions
summary: OPEC+ kept its December oil production targets steady. The decision persists as ongoing conflicts involving Iran continue to disrupt global petroleum flows.
why: OPEC+ production quotas dictate global crude supply balances, directly influencing international oil prices, inflation expectations, and energy sector equities.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Maintaining production targets while flows are disrupted maintains tightness in physical crude markets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Unchanged production quotas set against active Middle East supply disruptions keep global crude availability constrained.
